reference.question: What is the name of the country with the most car makers?
reference.gold_sql: SELECT T2.CountryName FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 JOIN COUNTRIES AS T2 ON T1.Country = T2.CountryId GROUP BY T1.Country, T2.CountryName ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
